CVE-2024-41110 affects the Docker Engine daemon authorization-plugin request path. Telegraf vendors github.com/docker/docker for client-side Docker input integrations and does not run dockerd or the vulnerable daemon AuthZ code path.
Vulnerability only affects the Moby daemon component (dockerd), which is developed as moby/moby and is commonly referred to as Docker, or Docker Engine.
